card.title: Spare Them the Hassle
card.instruction: Hide a practical problem because you believe handling it alone is kinder than involving anyone else.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Enjoy your afternoon off. Your bike will be ready for tomorrow.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why's the repair shop asking me to collect a wheel?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: They've got your number on the ticket. I'll collect everything.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: A wheel? Is the rest at another shop?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Only until four. Stay with your book; I've planned a route that gets all of it home before you need it.

mechanism: A hides the fragmented bike repair and takes over collection so B's afternoon off remains undisturbed.
confusable: Unlike simple secret repair, the reason for withholding complexity must be sparing the other person involvement.
comparison: D39-b manages a timed collection route; D39-a manages lunch and bedding around a drip.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
